title: Euclidean Bochner integrals, representatives and parameter measurability
statement:
Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m,n\geq1$ and $r\geq0$ be integers and use Lebesgue measure on Euclidean spaces. A function $u:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf R^r$ measurable up to a null set has a Borel-measurable representative $u_0=u$ almost everywhere. Here measurable up to a null set means equal almost everywhere to a Borel-measurable function. Such a function is Bochner integrable exactly when $\int\|u\|<\infty$. For integrable $u,v$, real constants $a,b$ and an integrable scalar function $h$, one has
$$\int(au+bv)=a\int u+b\int v,\qquad \int h(x)c\,dx=\left(\int h\right)c\quad(c\in\mathbf R^r),\qquad \left\|\int u\right\|\leq\int\|u\|.$$
Integrability and the integral are unchanged by almost-everywhere equality. If $F:\mathbf R^m\times\mathbf R^n\to\mathbf R^r$ is Borel measurable, then $x\mapsto\int F(x,y)\,dy$ is Borel measurable, where the integral is assigned zero when that section is not integrable. No integrability on the whole product is required for this measurability assertion.

mathlib_match.how: One-line specializations per clause to Euclidean spaces and volume. Basic.lean:237 integral_add and integral_smul give linearity for integrable functions, Bochner/ContinuousLinearMap.lean:218 integral_smul_const gives the scalar-function formula; integral_congr_ae at :299 gives ae invariance, and norm_integral_le_integral_norm at :934 gives the norm bound. Function/L1Space/Integrable.lean:617 integrable_norm_iff supplies the norm criterion (integrability of the nonnegative scalar norm is its finite integral plus measurability); Function/L1Space/Integrable.lean:123 Integrable.congr supplies integrability invariance. The representative is AEStronglyMeasurable.mk with measurable_mk at AEStronglyMeasurable.lean:179 and ae_eq_mk at :184, using AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable at :479 for second-countable Euclidean target. For Borel F, Measurable.stronglyMeasurable and StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right at Integral/Prod.lean:68–74 give Borel measurability of the parameter integral. The target is separable and complete including r=0, and volume is sigma-finite.
